_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil has held for 62 straight windows with no directional breaker visible — ETF flows remain at zero, VIX is elevated but not spiking, and funding is positive but weak — so the statistically honest call is HOLD at Panic until a catalyst breaks the stalemate.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil and structural outflow pressure; narrative implies an UP recovery toward Disbelief based on the August analog, but does not state a formal direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND MVRV Z-score climbs above 30 with funding holding above 0.005% — would confirm a break toward Disbelief (UP).
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay below 10 for 3+ sessions AND VIX pushes above 70 with funding dropping below 0.003% — would signal a break down to Anxiety or deeper Panic (DOWN).
